page.title: 譲歩は流れに逆らう小さな力

analysis.summaryJa: 譲歩は予想に反する事実を認めても主たる結論を変えない関係を作る。although・though・even thoughは節を導き、thoughだけは会話的な文末の後置ができる。still・all the same・neverthelessは文どうしをつなぎ、despite・in spite ofは名詞句を受ける。even ifは仮定的な譲歩、no matter howは程度にかかわらない譲歩を表す。
grammarPoints: even thoughによる強い意外性
still / all the same / neverthelessによる文間の逆接
even ifとno matter howによる仮定・程度の譲歩
visualEvidence: 主流と逆向きの矢印が結論に逆らう事実を示している
thoughの吹き出しが文末の小さな付け足しを表している
節・文・名詞の三分類が接続形式の違いを示す
雨のミニ練習が名詞句にはdespite系を選ぶことを示す
commonTraps: althoughを会話的な文末副詞として置く
in spite ofの後に完全な節を直接置く
although節と主節をbutで二重接続する
even thoughの事実譲歩とeven ifの仮定譲歩を混同する

questions.prompt: ------- the revised schedule was inconvenient, every department accepted it.

choices.A: Despite
choices.B: Nevertheless
choices.C: Although
choices.D: In spite of

choices.B: although
choices.C: despite

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with a natural sentence-final concession.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly links two sentences with “nevertheless”.

choices.C: Although the repair was expensive. Nevertheless it prevented a longer shutdown.

questions.explanationJa: 接続副詞Neverthelessを独立した第二文の冒頭に置いた正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “in spite of”.

choices.A: In spite heavy traffic, the driver arrived before noon.
choices.B: In spite of traffic was heavy, the driver arrived before noon.
choices.C: Although of heavy traffic, the driver arrived before noon.
choices.D: In spite of heavy traffic, the driver arrived before noon.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that distinguishes fact from hypothesis correctly.

choices.A: Even though the price falls tomorrow, we will keep the current contract if it might happen.
choices.B: Despite the price will fall tomorrow, we will keep the current contract.
choices.C: Even if the price falls tomorrow, we will keep the current contract.
choices.D: Even if of a possible price fall, we will keep the current contract.

questions.explanationJa: 未確定の将来条件を譲歩として仮定するEven ifが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly expresses strong factual concession.

choices.B: Even though the elevator was out of service, the office opened on time.

questions.explanationJa: 既知の事実に対する強い意外性はEven though＋節で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct “no matter how” pattern.

choices.B: No matter how busily is the line, every caller receives a response.
choices.C: Despite how the line becomes busy, every caller receives a response.

questions.explanationJa: No matter how＋形容詞＋主語＋動詞の語順が正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “all the same”.

choices.C: The forecast is uncertain. All the same, we should prepare the outdoor area.

questions.translationJa: 予報は不確かです。それでも、屋外区域を準備すべきです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “the fact that” after a preposition.

choices.A: Despite the fact that demand fell, the factory retained all employees.
choices.B: Despite that demand fell, the factory retained all employees.
choices.C: In spite of demand fell, the factory retained all employees.
choices.D: Although the fact that demand fell, the factory retained all employees.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Although the office is small, it has excellent facilities.”

choices.B: The office lacks facilities because it is small.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The proposal was risky. Nevertheless, the board approved it.”

choices.B: The proposal became risky after the board withdrew approval.
choices.C: The board approved it in order to increase every risk.
choices.D: The board approved the proposal in spite of its risks.

questions.translationJa: リスクがあるにもかかわらず、取締役会は提案を承認しました。
questions.explanationJa: Neverthelessの文間譲歩をin spite of＋名詞句で言い換えています。

questions.explanationJa: Even ifは仮定した条件でも主たる判断が変わらないことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Despite the late hour, the support desk answered immediately.”

choices.B: Although it was late, the support desk responded at once.
choices.C: The late hour prevented the support desk from responding.

questions.explanationJa: despite＋名詞句をalthough＋節へ変換した同義文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The first trial failed. Still, the researchers continued.”

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The service is useful. It is expensive, though.”

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “In spite of the fact that the road was narrow, the truck passed safely.”

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Even though the store was crowded, checkout was quick.”
